column3: US-40 Cover an item or category as a gift
column5: As a member, I want to mark items or a whole category (e.g. all drinks) as "on me", so that I can treat friends without doing the maths.
column6:
1. Given B's drinks total RM 10.00 and A covers the drinks, when the split is calculated, then A owes RM 81.62 and B owes RM 34.98 (BR-13 example).
2. Given a gift is set, when anyone views the item, then it shows "Covered by A".
3. Given A removes the gift, when the split is recalculated, then all shares return to their previous amounts.

column5: As a group, we want to treat one member (e.g. on their birthday), so that their share is spread across the rest of us automatically.
column6:
1. Given Mei is treated with the proportional option, when the split is finalised, then Mei owes RM 0.00 and the others' shares rise in proportion to their subtotals.
2. Given the "equally" option, when the split is finalised, then Mei's share is divided equally among the others, with rounding by BR-05.
3. Given Mei opens her link, when she views the summary, then she sees "You've been treated" and not what others paid for her.

column3: US-45 Personal link for each member
column5: As a payer, I want each member to get a personal link, so that friends can act on the receipt without signing up and the app knows who is who.
column6:
1. Given a receipt with 5 members, when the payer taps "Let friends claim", then 5 unique links with 128-bit random tokens are created.
2. Given Daniel opens his link, when the page loads, then it greets him by name and shows only this receipt.
3. Given the payer revokes a link, when it is opened, then the page shows "This link is no longer active".

column5: As a friend, I want to tap the items I ate on my personal link, so that I only pay for my own food.
column6:
1. Given Daniel opens his link, when he taps "Nasi lemak", then it shows as claimed by him and his running total updates.
2. Given an item with quantity 3, when he claims 1, then 1 of 3 is assigned to him and 2 remain unclaimed.
3. Given the split is finalised, when he tries to change a claim, then claims are locked and a message explains why.
4. Given a poor connection, when he taps an item, then the claim is either saved or an error is shown; no tap is lost silently.

column3: US-47 Mark an item as shared
column5: As a friend, I want to mark an item as shared with others, so that shared dishes are split fairly.
column6:
1. Given Daniel and Ali both claim the satay, when shares are calculated, then each pays half.
2. Given Daniel taps "Shared with" and picks Ali and Mei, when he saves, then the satay is split 3 ways.

column5: As a payer, I want to see claim progress and be told when everything is claimed, so that I know when to finalise.
column6:
1. Given 3 of 12 items are unclaimed, when Aina opens the receipt, then she sees "9 of 12 items claimed" and which friends haven't opened their link.
2. Given the last item is claimed, when it is saved, then Aina gets a push notification "All items claimed".

column5: As a payer, I want to change or assign claims before finalising, so that mistakes are fixed and nothing is left unclaimed.
column6:
1. Given Daniel claimed a teh tarik by mistake, when Aina reassigns it to Ali, then both totals update and Daniel is notified.
2. Given 1 item is unclaimed, when Aina taps Finalise, then she is asked to assign it first (BR-08).

column3: US-52 Read discounts and promos from the receipt
column5: As a payer, I want discount, voucher and promo lines read from the receipt, so that I don't have to enter them myself.
column6:
1. Given a receipt with "VOUCHER -10.00", when it is extracted, then a bill-level discount of RM 10.00 is recorded, not an item.
2. Given "B1F1 Latte -12.00" below a latte line, when it is extracted, then an item-level discount is linked to that latte.
3. Given a discount line the AI can't place, when it is extracted, then it is flagged for review.

column3: US-53 Choose who benefits from a discount
column5: As a payer, I want to choose whether a discount helps everyone or only the item's owner, so that the split matches what the group agreed.
column6:
1. Given a RM 10.00 bill voucher with mode Everyone, and A has 60% and B 40% of the subtotal, when finalised, then A's share drops by RM 6.00 and B's by RM 4.00.
2. Given a RM 12.00 discount on B's latte with mode Item owner, when finalised, then only B's subtotal drops by RM 12.00 and charges are re-shared under BR-02.
3. Given the payer changes a discount's mode, when saved, then all shares recalculate immediately.

column3: US-54 Share a buy 1 free 1 fairly
column5: As a payer, I want to choose how a buy 1 free 1 is shared, so that the two people sharing the deal pay fairly.
column6:
1. Given two RM 12.00 lattes with one free, owned by A and B, when the mode is "average", then each pays RM 6.00 before charges.
2. Given the mode "free item goes to its owner", when finalised, then the owner of the free latte pays RM 0.00 for it.

column5: Question to answer: which channels can reach every member, including friends without the app or an email address? Compare push notifications, email and WhatsApp (automated messages usually need the paid WhatsApp Business Platform). Time box: 1 day. Output: decision D-11 in DOC-06.
column6:
1. A comparison of reach, cost, setup effort and consent for each channel is written in DOC-06.
2. Decision D-11 is agreed by A and B.

column3: US-58 Tell the payer I've paid
column5: As a friend, I want to tap "I've paid" and optionally attach a transfer screenshot, so that the payer knows without me sending a message.
column6:
1. Given Daniel owes RM 23.40, when he taps "I've paid", then his status becomes Marked paid and Aina is notified.
2. Given he attaches a screenshot, when Aina opens it, then she can see the image and nobody else can.

column5: As a payer, I want to confirm payments or record cash payments, so that everyone's status is accurate.
column6:
1. Given Daniel is Marked paid, when Aina confirms, then his status is Confirmed and his reminders stop.
2. Given Ali paid in cash, when Aina marks him as paid, then his status goes straight to Confirmed.
3. Given every participant is Confirmed, when the last one is confirmed, then the receipt shows "Settled".

column5: As a payer, I want the app to send polite reminders to friends who haven't paid, so that I don't have to chase them myself.
column6:
1. Given Daniel is Unpaid 24 hours after finalising, when the scheduler runs, then he receives a friendly reminder from the app.
2. Given a reminder falls due at 11 pm, when the scheduler runs, then it is held until 9 am Malaysia time.
3. Given Daniel has marked himself paid, when his next reminder time arrives, then nothing is sent.
4. Given 4 reminders have been sent, when the schedule continues, then no more are sent and Aina sees "Reminders finished".

column5: As a payer, I want to pause, resume or change reminders for each person, so that I stay in control of how my friends are contacted.
column6:
1. Given Aina pauses reminders for Ali, when reminders fall due, then none are sent to Ali until she resumes them.
2. Given Aina changes the schedule to every 2 days, when saved, then the next reminder follows the new schedule.

column5: As a payer, I want a one-tap prefilled WhatsApp reminder for friends the app can't reach, so that every friend can be reminded politely.
column6: 1. Given Ali has neither the app nor an email address, when Aina taps "Send reminder", then WhatsApp opens with a friendly message and Ali's personal link.

column3: US-65 See the receipt photo and full item list
column5: As a friend, I want to see the receipt photo and the full item list from my link, so that I can check the bill myself.
column6:
1. Given Daniel opens his link, when he taps "View receipt", then he sees the photo (zoomable) and every item with who claimed it.
2. Given his link has been revoked, when he opens the old photo address, then access is refused.

column3: US-66 See how my amount was calculated
column5: As a friend, I want a breakdown of my amount, so that I trust it.
column6:
1. Given Daniel owes RM 23.40, when he taps "How was this calculated?", then he sees his items, his part of shared items, and his share of service charge, tax, tip and discounts.
2. Given the breakdown is shown, when the lines are added, then they equal RM 23.40 exactly.

column5: As a member, I want to comment on an item, so that I can query it without an argument in the group chat.
column6:
1. Given Daniel comments "I didn't order this" on a teh tarik, when he posts it, then the comment shows on that item and Aina is notified.
2. Given Aina replies, when she posts, then Daniel is notified.

column5: As a payer, I want to resolve item queries by editing the item or replying, so that disputes are closed quickly.
column6:
1. Given an open comment, when Aina edits the item, then shares recalculate and she can mark the comment resolved.
2. Given 1 open comment, when Aina taps Finalise, then she sees "1 open question" but can continue.

column5: As a user, I want receipts categorised automatically, so that I don't have to tag them.
column6:
1. Given a receipt from a nasi kandar restaurant, when it is extracted, then its category is suggested as "Mamak".
2. Given I have a saved rule for that merchant, when a new receipt from it is extracted, then my rule wins over the AI suggestion.

column5: As a user, I want to change a receipt's category and have the app remember it for that merchant, so that my summaries stay accurate.
column6: 1. Given Aina changes a receipt from "Café" to "Mamak" for merchant X, when she saves, then future receipts from X are categorised as Mamak for her.

column5: As a user, I want a monthly summary of my own share by category with the change from last month, so that I understand my spending.
column6:
1. Given Aina's share of eating out is RM 310 in November and RM 258 in October, when she opens the summary, then it shows "RM 310, up 20%".
2. Given Aina paid a RM 200 bill but her share was RM 40, when the summary is calculated, then only RM 40 is counted (BR-20).
3. Given there was no spending last month, when the summary is shown, then no percentage is shown.

column5: As a user, I want a notification at the start of each month, so that I remember to check my spending.
column6:
1. Given it is 9 am on the 1st of the month, when the job runs, then users who spent anything last month get a summary notification.
2. Given a user has opted out in settings, when the job runs, then they get nothing.

column3: US-78 Net balances across an event
column5: As a trip organiser, I want all receipts in the event combined into one balance per person, so that we can see who owes what overall.
column6:
1. Given the 4-person trip example in section 3, when balances are calculated, then they are +150.00, +50.00, −50.00 and −150.00.
2. Given any event, when balances are calculated, then they add up to RM 0.00.

column5: As a group, we want the app to suggest the fewest transfers, so that we settle with as few payments as possible.
column6:
1. Given the trip example, when the plan is generated, then it shows 2 transfers: D pays A RM 150.00 and C pays B RM 50.00.
2. Given an event with n members, when the plan is generated, then it has at most n − 1 transfers.

column3: US-80 Mark settlement transfers as paid
column5: As a member, I want to mark each settlement transfer as paid, so that the trip is settled with the same payment flow as single receipts.
column6:
1. Given D pays A, when D marks it paid and A confirms, then the transfer is Confirmed.
2. Given a settlement transfer is unpaid, when reminders fall due, then BR-18 reminders apply to it.

column3: US-83 Spike: validate payment details feature
column5: Question to answer: do users want the payer's DuitNow QR or bank details shown, and can we show them safely? Check survey Q10, ask 3 interviewees, and review privacy. Time box: 1 day. Output: decision D-10 (go / no-go).
column6:
1. Findings and decision D-10 are written in DOC-06.
2. FR-30 status changes from Proposed to Approved or Dropped.

column5: As a payer, I want to add my DuitNow QR image or bank details once, so that friends can pay me without asking.
column6:
1. Given Aina uploads her DuitNow QR, when she saves, then it is stored privately and shown in her profile.
2. Given she removes it, when friends open their links, then it is no longer shown.

column3: US-85 See how to pay the payer
column5: As a friend, I want to see the payer's QR and copy their account number, so that I can pay in seconds.
column6:
1. Given Daniel opens his personal link, when he views the summary, then he sees the payer's QR with "Save image" and "Copy account number".
2. Given someone opens a public link, when the page loads, then no payment details are shown.
